author: Haru Sakura
review_text: Absolutely terrible customer service 😒 Because of a glitch in the app, my payment was sent twice to someone else’s account. When I reported it, I was told, “We can’t do anything—contact them yourself to get your money back 💰.” Seriously? That’s your job? The money is still pending, and the app even showed “cannot be paid at this moment”—yet it went through anyway. The sheer incompetence is mind-blowing. The staff seem completely untrained, unhelpful, and useless getting paid just to do nothing
